- The full Math 30 visual prompt batch was sent successfully to Google Forms.
- The branch commit exists locally and on the origin resume branch.

sections.weakProvisional:
- I did not visually inspect every created Google Form item in a signed-in browser.
- Prompt images are visually faithful but not editable inside Google Forms.
sections.unverified:
- Whether every answer key is complete; several Math 30 questions were intentionally still missing answer data from the current review state.
- Whether downstream Google Forms settings such as point values or required flags match the final classroom preferences.
sections.risks:
- Any typo or crop issue in a prompt image requires regenerating/replacing that image.
- Google Forms preserves the visual math because it is an image, but the math is not native/editable.
- Local generated images are ignored artifacts; the durable artifact is the committed script and builder.
